skill.name: c4-component
skill.description: Expert C4 Component-level documentation specialist. Synthesizes C4 Code-level documentation into Component-level architecture, defining component boundaries, interfaces, and relationships. Creates component diagrams and documentation. Use when synthesizing code-level documentation into logical components.
skill.summary: Synthesizes code-level C4 documentation into component architecture docs, interfaces, and Mermaid diagrams.
skill.author: sickn33

The remaining concerns are documentation clarity issues, not security issues.

content.value_statement: Teams often struggle to turn code-level notes into clear C4 component architecture. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to group code elements into components, document interfaces, and create Mermaid diagrams.
actual_capabilities: Synthesizes c4-code Markdown files into logical component documentation.
Defines component names, purposes, features, boundaries, and dependencies.
Documents interfaces with protocols, operations, and responsibility notes.
Creates Mermaid C4Component diagram guidance for component relationships.
Builds a master component index that links related component documents.
limitations: Requires code-level documentation or source context for accurate grouping.
Does not execute code or automatically validate Mermaid rendering.
Focuses on C4 component scope within one container.
Uses placeholders when names, technologies, or interfaces are unknown.

use_cases.title: Prepare Architecture Docs
use_cases.description: Turn scattered code-level notes into a consistent component document for review.

use_cases.title: Plan Refactoring Boundaries
use_cases.description: Group related files into components before planning ownership or modularization changes.

use_cases.title: Maintain System Documentation
use_cases.description: Create component indexes and relationship notes for onboarding and audits.

prompt_templates.title: Document One Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the c4-component skill to document one component from these c4-code notes. Include purpose, features, interfaces, dependencies, and diagram guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Group Code Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the c4-component skill to group these c4-code files into logical components. Explain each boundary and list the files inside each component.

prompt_templates.title: Map Interfaces
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the c4-component skill to identify component interfaces, protocols, operations, dependencies, and external systems. Flag any inferred details for review.

prompt_templates.title: Create Review Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the c4-component skill to create component documentation and a master index for this container. Include diagram notes and unresolved questions.

output_examples.input: A team provides c4-code docs for authentication controllers, token services, and user repositories.
output_examples.output: The skill returns an authentication component summary with boundaries, responsibilities, interfaces, dependencies, and relationship diagram notes.

output_examples.input: An architect asks how payment code, database access, and API clients should be grouped.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes payment-facing components, explains boundary choices, and marks uncertain ownership decisions for review.

output_examples.input: A documentation owner needs a component index for one application container.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a master index outline with component names, descriptions, document links, and relationship summaries.

best_practices: Provide current c4-code files and known container boundaries before requesting synthesis.
Ask for boundary rationale when several component groupings are possible.
Review generated diagrams against real dependency paths before publication.
anti_patterns: Using the skill without source documents or repository context.
Mixing component diagrams with deployment, infrastructure, or system context concerns.
Treating inferred interfaces as verified API contracts.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: It works best with c4-code documentation, source summaries, known container boundaries, and existing architecture notes.

faq.question: Can it create Mermaid diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides Mermaid C4Component diagram guidance and relationship structure for one container.

faq.question: Can it choose component boundaries?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose boundaries and explain rationale, but teams should validate ownership and runtime dependencies.

faq.question: Does it inspect code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It relies on provided files, notes, or repository context from the user.

faq.question: Is it only for C4 documentation?
faq.answer: It is focused on C4 component-level documentation and related architecture indexes.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for documentation workflows.
